RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias is unsubstantiated and risks damaging your professional reputation. An all-female panel is not inherent evidence of discrimination, just as an all-male panel does not inherently indicate bias against women. Modern newsrooms heavily prioritize digital media strategy, which is a legitimate competency that can outweigh longer tenure in traditional news. 

Additionally, a two-week delay in receiving recruitment feedback is common administrative lag, not an admission of impropriety. Rather than making an issue of the panel's demographics, follow up politely on your feedback request to understand how the panel evaluated the role's strategic criteria and your interview performance.
